projects.title: JusticeGuide
projects.subtitle: AI Legal Research Assistant
projects.description: Enables non-lawyers, students, and litigants to query the Indian Penal Code in plain language. Delivers cited, source-grounded answers in under 2 seconds.
projects.problem: Legal research is slow and inaccessible for people who do not know exact IPC sections or legal phrasing.
projects.impact: Plain-language questions return cited, source-grounded answers in under 2 seconds across 189 indexed IPC chunks.

pipeline.detail: Groq query expansion for better retrieval
Answer with sources in under 2 seconds

projects.title: LogLens
projects.subtitle: AI Log Analysis System
projects.description: Converts raw server log dumps into structured P1–P4 incident reports in seconds. Solves the on-call problem of diagnosing production failures under time pressure.
projects.problem: On-call engineers lose time scanning noisy logs before they can identify severity, clusters, and probable root cause.
projects.impact: Raw logs become structured P1-P4 incident reports with anomaly signals, semantic clusters, and deterministic fallback logic.

pipeline.detail: Anomaly detection on error-rate, latency, silence

projects.title: AI Resume Screener
projects.subtitle: Automated Candidate Ranking
projects.description: Screens and ranks resumes against job descriptions automatically. Improved recruiter matching accuracy from 72% to 85% and cut manual shortlisting time significantly.
projects.problem: Recruiters need consistent resume-to-JD matching without manually comparing every candidate profile.
projects.impact: A 9-algorithm ensemble improved matching accuracy from 72% to 85% with cached rankings and Prometheus latency tracking.

pipeline.detail: BERT, SBERT, TF-IDF, XGBoost, SVM, MLP, RF, DistilBERT, NER
Weighted rank fusion across all signals
